source.description: Five RAW daily closes plus a split and cash-dividend ledger for exact V1.4 accounting checks

semantics.prices: RAW close in CNY; integer cents after parsing; corporate actions are independent events and prices are never adjusted

sessions.calendar: Fixture session sequence only; not an exchange calendar

qualityCases: 10-cent-per-share cash dividend with later pay date

Repeated identical dividend event ID is applied only once
Raw closes remain 500 and 490 cents around split and ex-date; adjusted prices are not applied on top of cash/quantity accounting
